copy.zh: 湖面如镜，倒映秋色与雾中山脊。右岸陡壁旁停着一辆绿白巴士，中景有几辆白车。初雪贴着峰线，旅途的痕迹很小，山色很大。
copy.en: Glass-calm water mirrors autumn trees and misted ridges. A green-and-white coach sits by the cliff road; a few white cars further in. First snow along the peaks—travel traces small, the mountain large.

copy.zh: 左岸金黄落叶松中夹一棵深红，右侧有矮岛灌丛。峰顶雾雪交叠，湖面几乎无纹。一点红，整幅冷调才有了温度。
copy.en: Among golden larches on the left, one deep red crown; a low brushy islet to the right. Mist and snow on the peaks; water nearly glass. One red note warms the whole cool frame.

alt.zh: 红枫映水 摄影作品
alt.en: Red Maple on Still Water photograph

copy.zh: 前景新雪与枯草，中景静湖与金黄针叶林。岸左一枚大红心形装置，游人彩色衣点散落。远山入雾，一点红把冷场轻轻点醒。
copy.en: Fresh snow and dry grass in front; still lake and golden conifers mid-frame. A large red heart sculpture on the left shore; colorful walkers scattered. Far peaks in mist—one red note waking the cold.

alt.zh: 雪岸红心 摄影作品
alt.en: Red Heart on Snow Shore photograph

copy.zh: 绿坡上一条细土路，左下有穿亮黄外套的行人。后方岩峰与雪线被雾气遮住大半，天色白茫。一点高亮衣色，整幅山才有了尺度。
copy.en: A thin dirt path crosses the green slope; lower left, a walker in a bright yellow jacket. Rocky peaks and snow behind dissolve into mist under a white sky. That one high note of color sets the mountain’s scale.

alt.zh: 黄衣行者 摄影作品

copy.zh: 湖面呈淡青，近岸灌丛压在暗影里。对岸草甸窄窄一条，再往后是带雪的岩峰与层积云。风不大，水色静，山体的阴影把高处的冷意写得很清楚。
copy.en: Pale turquoise water fills the foreground, scrub dark along the near shore. A thin meadow sits before rocky peaks patched with snow and piled cumulus. Little wind; the quiet surface and mountain shade make the altitude feel sharp and still.

alt.zh: 雪峰下的湖与路 摄影作品

copy.zh: 前景大片绿丘，小路蜿蜒，几棵矮树点缀。左后方雪峰明亮，白云贴着山腰，头顶蓝天开朗。阴天之后的这一口气，山色一下子透亮。
copy.en: A broad green hill fills the front, a faint path winding past a few small trees. Left rear, a snow peak brightens; white cloud hugs the mid-slope under clear blue. After grey weather, the mountain suddenly breathes light.
